WHAT: Automated eval that uses Gemini vision to score search result quality against reference photo
WHERE: scripts/eval-match.ts
HOW: Take Chrome screenshot of Vinted results grid (20 items visible). Save reference photo. Send both to Gemini 2.0 Flash with prompt: 'Here is a reference outfit photo and a grid of 20 Vinted search results. List which results match the [item] in the reference photo and which don't, and explain why each mismatch is wrong.'
WHY: Claude's vision is too weak to reliably compare fashion items at grid zoom. Gemini is better at visual fashion comparison.
GOTCHA: This approach uses Chrome screenshots directly — NOT downloading listing images via API. The ralph-loop skill automates this cycle but had permission errors with the loop command format. Currently semi-manual: take screenshot, run eval script, read feedback, fix code, rescan.
